title: A linear recurrence bounds the shift span
statement: Let $K$ be a field [def-weil-field], $m\geq0$, $d\geq1$ integers, $a_0,\ldots,a_{d-1}\in K$, and $(c_n)_{n\geq0}$ a sequence in $K$ satisfying the linear recurrence of order $d$ with coefficients $a_0,\ldots,a_{d-1}$ from the index $m$ on [def-weil-eventual-linear-recurrence]. For $j\geq0$ let $R_j=(c_{j+s})_{s\geq0}\in K^{\mathbf Z_{\geq0}}$. Then every $R_j$ lies in the $K$-linear span of $R_0,\ldots,R_{m+d-1}$. Consequently the subspace $V\subseteq K^{\mathbf Z_{\geq0}}$ [def-weil-sequence-subspace] spanned by all $R_j$ is finite-dimensional [def-weil-finite-dimensional-subspace] with $\dim_KV\leq m+d$ [def-weil-vector-space-dimension].
